title: audit detail auth.passkey_bundle
description: detail of audit rows with action auth.passkey_bundle: the identity bundle of one of the user's passkeys was stored or replaced (PUT /v1/me/bundles/passkey:<credential>); the target is the passkey's credential reference. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
